notes: Employees: the FY2025 10-K states hourly and salaried counts separately (approximately 88,000 hourly, 56%, and 68,000 salaried, 44%) but no total, so the head count is the sum of the two parts (computedFrom); source quotes the sentence that states both. Substantially all of the approximately 47,000 hourly U.S. employees are represented by unions. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, wages or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (ratio 333:1).
